Evidence wording clarification: the regression assertions FAILED on pristine Forge because all three APIs ACCEPTED the forged signature. Patched APIs reject it. Removing the high-severity installed verifier caused nine assertion failures; byte-identical restoration returned all 139 focused controls to green. This clarifies the prior note and does not add endpoint, hosted, native, or release qualification.
